provider-error.gone.check.zh: {provider} 停用了 Lumi 检查密钥用的接口，跟你的密钥无关。Lumi 更新后才能连上。
provider-error.gone.check.en: {provider} has retired the endpoint Lumi uses to check keys. Your key isn’t the problem; Lumi needs an update before it can connect.

provider-error.gone.model.zh: {provider} 停用了你选的模型。去设置换一个模型，再试一次。
provider-error.gone.model.en: {provider} has retired the model you chose. Pick another one in Settings, then try again.

provider-error.gone.only-model.zh: {provider} 停用了 Lumi 用的模型。Lumi 更新后才能再用。
provider-error.gone.only-model.en: {provider} has retired the model Lumi uses. Lumi needs an update before you can use it again.

provider-error.denied.zh: {provider} 拒绝了这次请求，可能是地区或账号权限的问题。
provider-error.denied.en: {provider} refused this request. It may be your region or account permissions.
